title: Thai Chaat Pasta Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Thai and Indian flavors in a quick and easy pasta stir fry. The tender tagliatelle is cooked with juicy chaat, spices, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Cook the tagliatelle according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat. Add the sliced onion and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the chaat and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to soften.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, and fish sauce (if using). Stir well to combine.
Add the cooked tagliatelle to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the pasta is well coated with the sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (if desired).
Optional: Add some heat with red pepper flakes or sliced fresh chili peppers.
